item.title: Everlight Electronics' 2Q26 gross margin hit by raw material costs, recovery expected in 2H26
item.summary: LED packaging manufacturer Everlight Electronics stated that due to higher raw material costs, gross margin fell to 24.16% in the second quarter of 2026, down 7.93pp year-over-year and 0.5pp from the first quarter, mainly due to fluctuations in the Chinese yuan exchange rate.
